analysis: Post-hoc paired trial reconciliation and score factorization
scope: Independent reanalysis of existing200 requests; no new inference. Prior published archive summaries, including four aggregate native-score cells, were inspected before this specification. Do not present as preregistered discovery.
factors: Captured native versus corrected prompt outputs crossed with shipped versus source-correct references. Use same native heuristic parser for both reference routes. Report strict complete-single-answer evidence separately.
decomposition: For each model and stratum, report four finite-panel cells; label effect at each prompt, prompt effect at each reference, interaction=(fixedprompt_source-fixedprompt_shipped)-(nativeprompt_source-nativeprompt_shipped), and jointscore effect. Verify both algebraic path sums.
unknown_policy: Primary source-correct gain uses all50 per model and exact original regex; retain missing/incomplete/no-unique-tag as unknown and give worst/best paired gain. Do not equate heuristic score changes with valid-answer accuracy.
resources: Verify raw capture request identities/stream hashes using existing independent capture checker, count each200 request once including six incomplete, sum raw usage once with Decimal. Currency and global project spend remain unknown unless explicitly evidenced.
limits: Joint prompt repair changes question binding and brace formatting; no design cell isolates these components.
